---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect CLI behavior with a safe, reproducible example
title: "[Bug] "
---

## What happened?

Describe the actual behavior and why it seems wrong.

## Expected behavior

What should ReorderWitness have reported instead?

## How to reproduce

Include the complete command, the interpreter and operating-system versions, and the relevant exit code. Supply a **minimal synthetic** JSONL input and target command if possible.

```text
python --version
reorderwitness --input ...
```

## Evidence

Paste the relevant error text or a **sanitized** excerpt of `report.json`. Explain whether the same command produces the same result on repeat runs.

## Additional context

Any relevant execution-budget options, CI logs, or other information.

**Do not post secrets, personal records, production data, or suspected exploitable security issues here.** Security reports should use the [private reporting channel](https://github.com/alkinbg/ReorderWitness/security/advisories).
